description_en: Invokes a specified service on a single device
description_zh: 调用该接口在单个设备上调用指定服务
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual invoke-thing-service --identifier SetNum --product-key a1Bw000000 --device-name Device01 --args '{"param1":1}' --iot-id C47T6xwp6ms4bNlkHRWCg40000 --api-version 2023-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InvokeThingService

parameters.help_en: The service identifier in the Thing Specification Language (TSL) model
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the video device belongs.

<notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备所属产品的ProductKey。

<notice>如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the video device.

<notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备的设备名称。

<notice>如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en: The input parameters of the service to invoke. The value is a JSON string, such as Args={"param1":1}
parameters.help_zh: 要启用服务的入参信息，数据格式为JSON String，例如Args={"param1":1}
parameters.name: args

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the video device.
<notice>
IotId is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName on a one-to-one basis. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备的设备ID。
<notice>
IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id
